blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Electron microscopy (EM) serves as a cornerstone in virology enabling the visualization of viral particles and is widely used in research, diagnostics and morphological characterization of pathogens. Computer-assisted image analysis can help facilitate and speed up this labor-intensive method, however, typical EM virus datasets are small and sparsely labeled, resulting in a lack of readily available deep learning models due to training limitations. To overcome data shortages and leverage content-rich, diverse sample backgrounds, we employed background-based data augmentation. To this end, we propose Bg-Mix, a form of data augmentation method, which decomposes training images into foreground objects and backgrounds and subsequently rearranges both into novel augmented images. This not only enhances the performance of object detection models but also increases the diversity of the training data. Using Bg-Mix provides an increase between +0.8 and +3.3 box mean average precision (mAP) points over the baseline when tested across two datasets using two architectures, thereby demonstrating its effectiveness.
blocks.zh: 电子显微镜(EM)是病毒学的一个基石,能够使病毒颗粒可视化,并被广泛用于病原体的研究,诊断和形态特征鉴定. 计算机辅助的图像分析可以帮助促进并加速这种劳动密集型的方法,然而,典型的EM病毒数据集很少,而且标签很少,因此由于培训限制,缺乏现成的深层学习模型. 为了克服数据短缺,利用内容丰富、样本背景多样的情况,我们采用了基于背景的数据扩充。 为此,我们提出Bg-Mix,一种数据增强方法,将训练图像分解为前景对象和背景,并随后将两者重新排列为新颖的增强图像. 这不仅会提高物体检测模型的性能,而且会增加训练数据的多样性. 使用 Bg-Mix 可以在使用两个架构在两个数据集中测试时,在+0.8和+3.3框平均值精度(mAP)点比基线多出一分,从而显示其有效性.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Negative-staining Scanning-Transmission/Transmission Electron Microscopy (STEM/TEM) of clinical samples can help diagnose unknown and emerging infections [ 5 ] . Recognizing virus particles in those images, however, requires expert knowledge: viruses must be differentiated from debris and cell material, and morphologically similar viruses must be distinguished from one another. Automated virus detection can reduce the workload of experts by alleviating the need for labor-intensive manual analysis, while potentially enabling faster and more accurate diagnoses.
blocks.zh: 临床样本的阴性扫描-传播/传播电显微镜(STEM/TEM)有助于诊断未知和新出现的感染[5]. 然而,在这些图像中识别出病毒颗粒需要专家知识:病毒必须区别于碎片和细胞材料,形态上类似的病毒必须相区别。 自动检测病毒可以减少专家的工作量,减轻劳动力密集型人工分析的需要,同时有可能促成更快和更准确的诊断。

blocks.en: In light of the rise of deep learning methods in imaging and microscopy data availability, a myriad of models for object detection/instance segmentation [ 6 , 13 ] and classification [ 14 , 15 ] have been developed over the past decade. Still, biomedical imaging datasets remain costly to acquire and particularly time-consuming to annotate, often resulting in limited dataset availability and size. Several strategies have been proposed to address these limitations, including transfer learning [ 9 ] , synthetic image generation [ 8 ] , and data augmentation [ 4 ] . In this work, we focus on the latter strategy, which is particularly well suited to negative-staining STEM/TEM images because of their content-rich backgrounds.
blocks.zh: 鉴于成像和显微镜数据提供方面的深层学习方法的兴起,过去十年中开发出多种模型,用于物体探测/内分解[6、13]和分类[14、15]。 然而,生物医学成像数据集的获取成本仍然很高,对注释来说尤其耗时,往往导致数据集的可用性和规模有限。 为解决这些局限性,提出了若干战略,包括转移学习[9]、合成图像生成[8]和数据增强[4]。 在这项工作中,我们侧重于后一项战略,该战略特别适合负面的STEM/TEM图像,因为其内容丰富。

blocks.en: In recent years, several methods have been proposed for data augmentation: In the Copy-Paste method [ 3 ] , objects are cut from a random training image and pasted at random on another training image. The model in [ 17 ] learns the kind of background each class appears on and pastes objects only where the background fits. In [ 10 ] the labeled objects are kept intact and only the background is synthetically generated by using diffusion models [ 12 ] .
blocks.zh: 近年来,提出了若干数据扩充方法: 在Copy-Paste方法 [3]中,对象被从随机训练图像中剪去并被随机粘贴到另一个训练图像上. [17]中的模型学会了每门课中出现的背景类型,并只在背景相适合的地方粘贴对象. 在[10]中,标注的物体保持完好无损,只有背景通过使用扩散模型合成生成[12].

blocks.en: All of the above works use large numbers of natural training images, for example from the COCO dataset [ 11 ] . However, STEM/TEM datasets are often limited in size, typically comprising only a few hundred annotations, making data augmentation particularly valuable for supervised learning approaches.
blocks.zh: 上述所有作品都使用了大量自然训练图像,例如从COCO数据集[11]. 然而,STEM/TEM数据集的大小往往有限,通常只有几百个说明,使数据扩充对监督学习方法特别有价值。

blocks.en: Here, we propose Bg-Mix , a data augmentation method where segmented objects are extracted from one training image, an object-free background is extracted from another one and both are subsequently rearranged into a new augmented training image. We thus make use of the rich and diverse negative-stained STEM/TEM backgrounds without the need to either learn them or generate them artificially. We tested three ways to obtain object-free backgrounds, two ways to blend the object’s edges and six ways to place the foreground objects. We evaluate on two public negative-stained STEM/TEM virus datasets with two model architectures including an ablation study on different Bg-Mix modes and compare with the previously described Copy-Paste method.
blocks.zh: 在此,我们提议Bg-Mix,一种数据增强方法,即从一个训练图像中取出分块对象,从另一个训练图像中取出一个无对象背景,然后将两者重新排列成一个新的训练图像。 因此,我们利用丰富多彩的有负面污点的STEM/TEM背景,而不需要学习这些背景或人工产生这些背景。 我们测试了三种方法来获得无对象背景,两种方法来混合对象的边缘,以及六种方法来放置前方对象. 我们评价了两个公共负层的STEM/TEM病毒数据集,其中包含两个模型架构,其中包括对不同Bg-Mix模式的减速研究,并与之前描述的Copy-Paste方法进行比较.

blocks.en: 2 Method
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: 2.1 Overview
blocks.zh: 2.1 概览

blocks.en: Bg-Mix randomly extracts foreground objects and object-free backgrounds from training images in a given dataset and subsequently mixes them back together to form new training samples (cf. Fig. 1 ).
blocks.zh: Bg-Mix从给定数据集的训练图像中随机取出前地对象和无对象背景,并随后将它们相接回并组合,形成新的训练样本(参见图1).

blocks.en: Figure 1: Bg-Mix . The background of a random training image (a) and the foreground objects of another random training image (b) are extracted and blended to form the background-augmented image (c).
blocks.zh: 图1: Bg-Mix. 一个随机训练图像(a)的背景和另一个随机训练图像(b)的前缘对象被取出并混合,形成背景放大图像(c).

blocks.en: 2.2 Background Extraction
blocks.zh: 2.2 背景提取

blocks.en: From a randomly drawn training image, the background is extracted in one of the following three ways: A. Selecting the largest object-free square in the image and resizing it back to the image size, B. Removing its objects using segmentation masks and setting the pixels of the mask to zero, C. Removing its objects using segmentation masks and applying biharmonic inpainting [ 2 ] , which fills the mask by smooth interpolation based on the surrounding pixel values.

blocks.en: 2.4 Object Placement
blocks.zh: 2.4 对象放置

blocks.en: We consider six object placement methods depending on the foreground, background and the placement order: F. Foreground objects from one image, hence one class, are pasted onto a background from any class at their original positions, G. Foreground objects from one image, hence one class, are pasted onto a background from the same class at their original positions, H. Foreground objects from multiple images of a single class are pasted onto a background from any class at random non-overlapping positions, I. Foreground objects from multiple images of a single class are pasted onto a background from the same class at random non-overlapping positions, J. Foreground objects from multiple images of any class are pasted onto a background from any class at random non-overlapping positions, K. At least one foreground object from each class is pasted onto a background from any class at random non-overlapping positions.
blocks.zh: 我们考虑根据前景、背景和放置顺序的六个对象放置方法:一个图像的F. 前景对象,因此一个类被粘贴到任何类的原位置的背景上,一个图像的G. 前景对象,因此一个类被粘贴在同一个类的原位置上,H. 单一类的多幅图像被粘贴到任何类的原位置上,I. 单一类的多幅图像被粘贴到同一类的原位置上,J. 任何类的多幅图像被粘贴到任何类的原位置上,K. 每个类至少有一个前景对象被粘贴在任意类背景上,随机不重叠的位置.

blocks.en: 3.1 Datasets
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集

blocks.en: For virus segmentation, we utilized two publicly available datasets in this study. In both datasets, each image contains objects of only one class, which enabled us to use class-matched backgrounds for experiments.
blocks.zh: 在病毒分解方面,我们利用了本研究中可公开获得的两个数据集。 在这两个数据集中,每个图像只包含一个类的物体,这使我们能够使用类相匹配的背景进行实验.

blocks.en: The EMViR dataset [ 7 ] contains 1084 negative-staining STEM images with segmentation masks of four classes of respiratory viruses (Adeno, Corona, Orthomyxo and Paramyxo), split into 762 training, 157 validation and 165 test images.
blocks.zh: EMViR数据集 [7] 包含有1084个带有分解口罩的有四类呼吸道病毒(Adeno, Corona, Orthomyxo和Paramyxo)的负色STEM图像,分为762个训练,157个验证和165个测试图像.

blocks.en: The virus dataset of [ 16 ] , abbreviated VISN in the following, contains 622 negative-staining TEM images with segmentation masks of six virus classes (SARS-CoV-2, H1N1, Respiratory syncytial, Herpes simplex, Adeno and Vaccinia), divided into 499 training and 123 test images.
blocks.zh: [16]的病毒数据集,缩写为VISN,包含有622个带有分解口罩的有6个病毒类(SARS-CoV-2,H1N1,呼吸同步,Herpes simplex,Adeno和Vaccinia)的有622个负层的TEM图像,被分为499个培训和123个测试图像.

blocks.en: As pre-processing steps, (1) the EMViR object masks were converted to COCO json annotations to match the VISN format, (2) a VISN validation set was created from a stratified 15% of the original training set, and (3) all images across both datasets were resized to 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 pixels and their annotations were rescaled proportionally.
blocks.zh: 作为预处理步骤,(1)EMVIR对象口罩被转换为COCO json说明来与VISN格式相匹配,(2)从原有训练集的15%分级创建了VISN验证集,(3)两个数据集的所有图像被调整为1024×1024 1024\times 1024像素,其说明被按比例调整.

blocks.en: 3.2 Training
blocks.zh: 3.2 培训

blocks.en: We evaluated Bg-Mix on both datasets with two object detection/instance segmentation architectures: Mask R-CNN [ 6 ] with a ResNet-50-FPN backbone and RTMDet-Ins-L [ 13 ] . Both models were initialized with weights pretrained on COCO [ 11 ] , implemented using the MMDetection toolbox [ 1 ] and fine-tuned on each dataset. We kept each architecture’s published optimizer and learning rate schedule and extended it to 500 epochs: SGD with momentum 0.9 and weight decay 10 − 4 10^{-4} , with the learning rate divided by 10 at epochs 333 and 458, for Mask R-CNN, and AdamW with weight decay 0.05 and cosine decay from epoch 250 for RTMDet-Ins. With a uniform batch size of 8, we scaled the published learning rates linearly: from 0.02 (batch size 16) to 0.01 for Mask R-CNN, and from 0.004 (batch size 256) to 1.25 × 10 − 4 1.25\times 10^{-4} for RTMDet-Ins.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了两个数据集的Bg-Mix,有两个物体检测/内分解结构: 马斯克R-CNN [6] 有ResNet-50-FPN主干和RTMDet-Ins-L [13]. 两种模型都以COCO[11]的权重预先训练入手,采用MM检测工具箱[1]实施,并在每个数据集上进行微调. 我们保留了每个建筑所出版的优化和学习速度表,并将其扩展至500个纪元:0.9和重量衰减的SGD 10 - 4 10-Q-4},在333和458个纪元中将学习速度除以10, 对于Mask R-CNN, 以及从250个纪元中将重量衰减为0.05和余弦衰减的AdamW。 统一批量大小为8个,我们将公布的学习率线性地进行:从0.02(批量大小为16个)到0.01的Mask R-CNN,从0.004(批量大小为256个)到1.25×10−4 1.25\times 10^{-4}的RTM Det-Ins.

blocks.en: Bg-Mix was applied independently to each training image with probability p p , so the number of training images per epoch stayed fixed. To observe the effect of Bg-Mix alone, no other augmentation was used. We compared Bg-Mix using the same architectures without augmentation (baseline) and with Copy-Paste [ 3 ] , the latter applied with the same probability as Bg-Mix : p = 0.5 p=0.5 on EMViR and p = 0.01 p=0.01 on VISN. This choice was made based on our observation that for the EMViR dataset, 0.25 ≤ p ≤ 0.75 0.25\leq p\leq 0.75 increased performance, but for the VISN dataset, p > 0.01 p>0.01 decreased the performance. We evaluated on the validation set every 10 epochs and kept the checkpoint with the best validation box mAP for testing. All runs were averaged over three random seeds.
blocks.zh: Bg-Mix被独立应用到每个有概率p的训练图像上,因此每个时代的训练图像数量保持不变. 仅观察Bg-Mix的效果,没有使用其他增强. 我们使用同样的架构进行Bg-Mix的对比而不用增强(基线),与Copy-Paste[3],后者的应用概率与Bg-Mix相同:p=0.5p=0.5在EMViR上,p=0.01p=0.01在VISN上. 这一选择是基于我们的意见,即对EMVIR数据集来说,0.25 ≤ p 0.75 0.25\leq p\leq 0.75 提高了性能,但对VISN数据集来说,p > 0.01 p>0.01降低了性能. 我们每10个世纪就对验证组进行评估 并将检查点保留在最好的验证箱mAP测试中 所有跑道平均在三个随机种子上。

blocks.en: 3.3 Results
blocks.zh: 3.3 结果

blocks.en: Bg-Mix obtained the largest gain on the EMViR dataset for both architectures (+2.6 and +3.3 box mAP) (cf. Table 1 ). For the VISN dataset, Bg-Mix had a small increase (+0.8 and +0.8 box mAP) for both models. The small increase for Bg-Mix (and the corresponding decrease for Copy-Paste) for the Mask R-CNN architecture and the VISN dataset can be attributed to the already saturated baseline (77.7 box mAP).
blocks.zh: Bg-Mix在EMVIR数据集上获得了两个架构的最大收益(+2.6和+3.3框mAP)(参见表1. 对于VISN数据集,Bg-Mix对两种模型都有小幅增加(+0.8和+0.8盒mAP). Bg-Mix(并相应减少Copy-Paste)对Mask R-CNN架构和VISN数据集的少量增加可归因于已经饱和的基线(77.7 box mAP).

blocks.en: From the ablation study involving the Mask R-CNN architecture and the EMViR dataset (cf. Table 2 ), we observe the following, reporting gains of box mAP in points averaged over all runs using the corresponding option: (1) Background Extraction: inpainting ( + 1.2 +1.2 ) and zeroing the object pixels ( + 1.1 +1.1 ) perform best, (2) Blending: hard edges are slightly better than blurred edges ( + 1.1 +1.1 vs. + 0.8 +0.8 ), and (3) Object Placement: original objects at their original positions work best ( + 2.0 +2.0 ). The best run combines inpainting, hard edges and original placement (run 5, 58.3 box mAP); the same setting is used for Bg-Mix in cf. Table 1 .
blocks.zh: 从涉及Mask R-CNN架构和EMVIR数据集的通缩研究(参见表2)中,我们观察到以下情况,即使用相应的选项,报告方框mAP在所有运行过程中的平均值: (1) 背景提取:涂入(+1.2+1.2)和将对象像素(+1.1+1.1)零化效果最佳, (2)搅拌:硬边略好于模糊边(+1.1+1.1对+0.8+0.8),和(3)物体放置:原始物体在原位置上效果最好(+2.0+2.0). 最好的跑会将印花,硬边和原始放入(运行于5,58.3个框的mAP);在参考中Bg-Mix使用相同的设置. 表1. 按区域开列的所需资源

blocks.en: 4 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 4 结论

blocks.en: This study describes Bg-Mix , a novel background augmentation method for virus detection in negative-staining STEM/TEM images: it extracts the objects from one training image, the object-free background from another and pastes the extracted objects onto this extracted background.
blocks.zh: 本研究描述了Bg-Mix,一种新型的背景增强方法,用于在负色的STEM/TEM图像中检测病毒:它从一个训练图像中取出对象,从另一个训练图像中取出无对象背景,将取出的对象粘贴在这个被取出的背景上.

blocks.en: Compared to the baseline, the performance of models improved significantly by incorporating the Bg-Mix method. Our study is limited to object detection of viruses in EM images, however, we believe our findings can be transferred to other modalities with target objects on content-rich backgrounds.
blocks.zh: 与基准相比,模型的性能通过采用Bg-Mix方法得到显著改善. 我们的研究仅限于在EM图像中检测病毒的物体,然而,我们认为我们的发现可以转移到其他模式中,目标物体具有丰富的内容背景.

blocks.en: 5 Compliance with ethical standards
blocks.zh: 5. 遵守道德标准

blocks.en: This study uses publicly available electron microscopy datasets of virus particles produced in vitro (EMViR [ 7 ] , VISN [ 16 ] ). No ethical approval was required.
blocks.zh: 本研究使用可公开获取的体外所出病毒颗粒电子显微分数据集(EMVIR [7],VISN [16]. 不需要道德方面的批准。
